explication: The AWS SDK for PHP lets application code call AWS services through generated service clients, with AwsClient providing shared configuration and request handling. The main path is client construction, operation invocation, request processing, and an AWS response/result. It also includes focused conveniences such as S3 transfers, encryption, and DynamoDB-backed sessions. The graph draws on the README and the supplied source index and excerpts; several protocol and middleware internals are indexed but not excerpted, so their detailed interactions are not expanded.
